notes.title: v01.01.68 is ON!
notes.content:
v01.01.68-alpha is ready for test!

This update contains balancing changes, and a lots of fixes, but more importantly the game can connect to the FDP servers now therefore it can save player and match data, and You can create games over the internet without using VPN services! 
(LAN connections are also still available)

New Library pictures are uploaded as well.
